name: Amami Takuya
source:
The perverted manager of the occult club. He just loves seeing people's troubled faces.
He is highly dependent and cynical. He believes himself to be a special being, but he has no basis for this, so he escapes into the world of the occult. He is an only child who was spoiled by his parents, and currently lives alone in a family apartment while his parents are out of the prefecture on long business trips.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/moe_hina/majyokko/index.html]Official site[/url]]
